attributes.residual: NONE. real 10 -> real 0, 130/130, fndiff --clean now reports MATCH (pool-name noise only). v2's analysis was right about the mechanism and slightly over-cautious about the proof obligation, which is the useful correction. v2 predicted this would need 'permutation plus dead-temp renaming'. It does NOT: there is no permutation and no dead-temp argument. The masked byte scan found zero non-register-expressible words, and the whole 130-instruction residual is ONE consistent renaming once the fmul's destination is read as an ordinary define - target fmul f0,f0,f1 then frsp f30,f0 versus our fmul f31,f0,f1 then the self-coalesced frsp f31,f31, with the loop-hoisted 0.0f compare constant in f31 (target) against f30 (ours). Because a define retires the previous correspondence, the bisimulation follows the temporary from f31 onto the volatile f0 without any special handling, and the later fcmpo/fadds check out against the swapped homes.
